info.title: Den-noh Coil
info.synopsis: La vicenda si svolge in Giappone nel 2026, undici anni dopo uno straordinario sviluppo in materia di realtà aumentata, percepibile alla popolazione grazie a speciali visori, i cyber occhiali. La giovane Yūko Okonogi, studentessa di sesta elementare il cui nome può essere letto come Yasako (ragazza gentile), si trasferisce con la famiglia nella cittadina di Daikoku, in cui vi è una massiccia presenza di cybertecnologia. Appena arrivata in città, Yasako, dal carattere dolce e remissivo, conoscerà i bambini locali e, in particolare, verrà a contatto con un'altra sua coetanea: Yūko Amasawa, hacker abilissima e dai modi bruschi, il cui nome, identico a quello della protagonista, può essere letto, invece, come Isaco (ragazza coraggiosa). Yasako si ritroverà immischiata in una serie di oscuri enigmi, che ruotano perlopiù attorno agli Illegal, dei bizzarri ammassi di sostanza nera semovente, in realtà virus informatici di origine sconosciuta, e al mondo dall'Altra Parte, un misterioso universo virtuale.

episodes.title: The Children with Glasses
episodes.synopsis: When Yasako and Kyoko's virtual pet dog, Densuke, goes missing, Yasako procures the assistance of a detective.

episodes.title: COIL Cyber Detective Agency
episodes.synopsis: Yasako and Fumie ask Yasako's grandmother to cure Densuke of his potentially fatal illness. In return, Yasako must agree to an interesting, and dangerous, bargain.

episodes.title: Yuko and Yuko
episodes.synopsis: With Densuke back, the Mojos drop him off with Isako. After freeing him from the illegal, Isako makes an enormous mistake in trying to unlock the virtual being.

episodes.title: Daikoku City Heike Club
episodes.synopsis: A battle breaks out at school! During the commotion, Fumie steals a mysterious piece of data from Amasawa.

episodes.title: The Metabug Scramble Bus Tour
episodes.synopsis: The Hackers' Club goes on a metabug expedition over the fringes of surrounding cyberspace lead by Isako.

episodes.title: The Red Automaton
episodes.synopsis: Yasako and Fumie begin an investigation into Haraken and Searchmaton. Under pressure, Haraken reveals something huge to Yasako and Fumie.

episodes.title: In Action!! The COIL Detective Agency
episodes.synopsis: Isako once again summons an illegal with the help of the Daikoku Hackers. With Yasako and Fumie working on an unrelated case, will the virus take over?

episodes.title: The Summer Festival and a Duel
episodes.synopsis: Isako hatches a risky plan, and Daichi's newly rekindled friendship with Fumie may suffer as a result.

episodes.title: Michiko-san from the Other Side
episodes.synopsis: The kids spend a dark and stormy night telling ghost stories and playing spooky games at school. Meanwhile, Haraken has an interesting other worldly experience.

episodes.title: Kanna's Diary
episodes.synopsis: Following clues left by Haraken's former research partner, Haraken, Fumie, and Yasako search for any new leads.

episodes.title: Sunken! Daikoku City
episodes.synopsis: Daichi's plan to acquire metabugs via a fish-type illegal doesn't go as planned and may endanger everyone in the virtual vicinity.

episodes.title: Daichi Grows Hair
episodes.synopsis: Yasako finds a race of microscopic illegals growing on their faces that are on the brink of destruction. Can Yasako figure out a way to save them?

episodes.title: The Last Plesiosaur
episodes.synopsis: A docile illegal follows the kids on a hazardous journey through the city, driven to find more of its kind.

episodes.title: Record of a Living Being
episodes.synopsis: Akira, Fumie's little brother, recalls the events thus far from his own perspective. Later, Haraken is warned by Nekome to stop investigating.

episodes.title: The Young Boy Beyond the Station
episodes.synopsis: Yasako searches for the place she met 4423. Afterward, she deduces that the place was a virtual space that was deleted.

episodes.title: Isako's Hospital Room
episodes.synopsis: Haraken and Fumie discover early accounts from previous denno users. Later, Yasako visits her comatose brother.

episodes.title: The Final Summer Vacation
episodes.synopsis: Haraken asks Isako to take him to the so-called "other world" in an effort to see if Kanna Ashihara still exists.

episodes.title: The Door to Another World
episodes.synopsis: Haraken barely makes it back through Isako's gateway. Tamako, fearing for his life, takes his glasses away. Meanwhile, trouble begins as a space appears behind Megabaa's shop.

episodes.title: The Dark Visitors
episodes.synopsis: With Kyoko on the "other side", Fumie and Yasako get help from Densuke to help guide Kyoko's denno body back to her real one.

episodes.title: Kanna and Yasako
episodes.synopsis: Haraken uses Kanna's glasses to sneak to the "other side." Yasako also enters with the help is Isako and Tamako.

episodes.title: The Dark Automaton
episodes.synopsis: Megamass is doing research on the "other side" and the effects of the den-noh coil. Isako finds herself drawn into it.

episodes.title: The Final COIL
episodes.synopsis: Yasako and Isako are running from Megamass. While hiding, they discover that Densuke might be able to open a stable portal.

episodes.title: The Granted Wish
episodes.synopsis: For various reasons, Nekome wants to join her brother on the other side, and the only way is to somehow convince Densuke to help.

episodes.title: The Children Who Throw Away Their Glasses
episodes.synopsis: The events surrounding Isako frighten the other parents. In an effort to keep their children safe, they confiscate their glasses, but at what cost?

episodes.title: The Kanazawa City Hazama Intersection
episodes.synopsis: Desperate to save Isako, Yasako finds a pair of glasses that belonged to her grandfather and uses them to travel to the other side.

episodes.title: Yasako and Isako
episodes.synopsis: Yasako comes face to face with the true nature of the Coil Domain and Michiko. Even with the support of her friends, can she save Isako?

info.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Divinez 2
info.synopsis: Settima stagione di Cardfight!! Vanguard

episodes.title: Destined Showdown
episodes.synopsis: After winning the Fated Clash and realizing his wish, Akina is confronted by the genius high school student Kuon Aikawa, who shows a strong interest in Akina and Suo. Meanwhile, Gabwelius summons the owners of the Fated One cards, revealing the true purpose of the Fated Clash and the existence of a formidable enemy.

episodes.title: Infinity vs Zero
episodes.synopsis: Sybilt declares the start of the Destined Showdown. Standing in their way are the six Destined Ones who have been mentally corrupted. To free those who share a deep connection with Akina and friends, they must be defeated in a fight! The first battle is Suo vs. Kuon. The clash between Zero and Infinity begins.

episodes.title: Guidance on the Scales
episodes.synopsis: Kyohma Kurosaki is Taizo's best friend and also his vice president. When Taizo asks, "What is the wish you want to make come true?" Kyohma's answer is...... The two emotions clash in the fight of Scales vs. Guiding Star.

episodes.title: Taboo and Protection, Truth of the Wish
episodes.synopsis: Taboo vs. Protection. Jinki stands on the ground of Hakusan with AI Gui to fulfill a certain wish. Masanori points out that Jinki's wish might be to resurrect his deceased brother, an act that violates the taboo of life and death, but... what could Jinki's true aim be?

episodes.title: Supreme Love For The Ever-changing You
episodes.synopsis: Yuna Saionji, a strong player in Net Vanguard, has an intense admiration for the supreme idol "Mi-tan." The incredible wish that Yuna wants is...!? Will victory go to the Supreme or the Ever-changing?!

episodes.title: Fighting Spirit Exceeding Unparalleled
episodes.synopsis: Unparalleled vs. Exceedance. Senka Kanae has been Nao's rival since elementary school. Even after they went their separate ways, Senka continued to thrive as a professional, drawing Nao's admiration. However, during the fight, Senka is inexplicably furious...!?

episodes.title: Light of Miracles, Shadow of Time
episodes.synopsis: Akina vs. Hikari, Miracles vs. Time, the sibling showdown begins once more! Hikari's wish in this battle is "to change her past". Upon seeing Akina's confusion, Hikari asks him once again. What is the wish that Akina truly desires for himself?

episodes.title: Point of Intersection
episodes.synopsis: The future Hikari appears before everyone. Despite having disappeared with the end of the Fated Clash, why is she here now...!? As the owner of the Fated One of Time, what is the reason for her to seek a fight with her past self? The battle of Time vs. Time begins now, leaving many mysteries unsolved!

episodes.title: Upon Those Who Reach Out
episodes.synopsis: The truth that the future Hikari wanted to convey to the present Hikari through the fight is now revealed. With all the battles decided, the Destined Showdown should have concluded, but an unimaginable ending awaits...!?

episodes.title: Descent of The Fated King
episodes.synopsis: The truth of what happened 10 years ago and Sybilt's aim are now revealed. The key to Sybilt's revival lies in the Design Force and Nao. It is the cause of Hikari's long suffering, and the theft of Nao's body. Akina's anger creates a miracle!

episodes.title: Awakening of The Destined King
episodes.synopsis: Kuon and Suo. A promise made in their childhood. Struggling in the midst of unresolved mental corruption, Kuon stakes everything he has and rises up to the fight!

episodes.title: Unparalleled Rakshasa
episodes.synopsis: Varga, transformed into the Drekasleif, overwhelms the Destined King. Only Akina and the Fated King can stop Sybilt's ambition of obtaining all the Design Force. The final showdown to take back Nao begins!

episodes.title: A Miracle Will Descend
episodes.synopsis: Akina faces a tough battle against Sybilt's immense power. But even though there's just a glimmer of hope, a miracle will descend upon those who reach out their hand. Holding onto Nao's words and Gabwelius's wishes, Akina fights on, believing in Rezael and miracles. The time for the final showdown has come!

info.title: Kosuke-sama Rikimaru-sama: Konpeitou no Ryuu
info.synopsis: Una storia d'avventura di arti marziali con cattivi che sarebbero potuti uscire dall'Esercito del Nastro Rosso, e mecha tipici di Toriyama.

info.title: Beyblade the Movie: Decisive Battle! Takao VS Daichi (ITA)
info.synopsis: Sho Tenma, del team Estrella, diventa campione del mondo di BeyWheelz e dovrà difendere il suo titolo dal team Dominators, e da chiunque desideri sfidarlo.

related.title: Beyblade the Movie: Decisive Battle! Takao VS Daichi

variants.title: Beyblade the Movie: Decisive Battle! Takao VS Daichi

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: Bladebreakers, the team that dominated the Beyblade World Tournament has split up. Max to America, Ray to China. Kai's whereabouts are unknown, and Tyson spends his days peacefully... Well not really running away from grandfather's training so that his passion toward beyblade doesn't cool off having become best in the world. As always worrying about him overdoing it, Tyson goes just perfectly for Professor anyway, that day, he had plans to battle the city tournament champion in the deciding battle of the competition, a mysterious boy who goes by the name of Mister X shows overwhelming difference in strength in the battle and it ends in his victory. This heartless method causes Tyson to fire off his dragon bullet. This boy who hides frightening true strength, who is his true self.

info.title: The Do-Over Damsel Conquers The Dragon Emperor
info.synopsis: Jill è una giovane nobildonna che sta per essere uccisa per ordine del suo fidanzato, il principe ereditario. Nel momento della sua morte la ragazza viene salvata da un salto temporale, ritrovandosi ad avere nuovamente 10 anni e rivivere la festa in cui venne deciso il suo fidanzamento. Per sfuggire al suo destino, Jill chiede aiuto ai presenti in sala imbattendosi casualmente nell'imperatore del regno vicino, che le presta ascolto.

episodes.title: I Tried to Avoid the Route to Destruction and Somehow Ended Up Courting My Greatest Enemy
episodes.synopsis: Betrayed by her fiancé, Jill's life nearly ends in frustration, but instead, she suddenly finds herself back on the night she was proposed to six years ago. To avoid the route that leads to her doom, she makes use of a man that crosses her path, but...

episodes.title: I Already Know the Tragedy That Is to Come, So I Will Do What I Can to Avoid It
episodes.synopsis: Hadis accepts Jill's proposal and gifts her the Dragon Consort's ring. After suffering a sudden enemy attack, they arrive in Beilburg. There, Sphere, a candidate to become Hadis's fiancée, and daughter of the local lord, comes running up to the ship.

episodes.title: The Situation Is Desperate, but as the God of War`s Daughter, I Will Defeat the Enemy with Brute Strength
episodes.synopsis: With the combined information from the other captives, Jill sees through the Marquess Beil's plot. Realizing that she must act quickly, and knowing that the others may not trust her, she takes a chance and asks for help. Will it be enough?

episodes.title: My Fiance Is Trying His Best to Woo Me and I Don`t Know What to Do About It
episodes.synopsis: Hadis must deal with Marquess Beil and his men. Will knowing Jill's wishes make a difference? And for Jill, hearing the heartless words the marquess hurls at Hadis makes her worry that Hadis pushes himself too hard.

episodes.title: When Seeking the Truth, Things Turned Into an Argument, So I Can No Longer Do Anything
episodes.synopsis: Prince Gerald goes to Beilburg to see if it's true that Jill was abducted. To deny the rumors, Hadis and Jill must show that they're happy, but it may not be so easy. Then their meeting with Gerald is cut short by distressing news of Marquess Beil.

episodes.title: Upstarts Are Attempting to Get Close to My Fiance and I Want to Beat Them at Their Own Game
episodes.synopsis: Hadis' enemies are conspiring against him. Jill has secretly worked out a plan to protect him, but she's locked inside a barrier and Rave won't let her out. Instead, he tells her the real reason she was chosen as the Dragon Consort.

episodes.title: I Want to Stop Living the Slow Life, So I Have Decided to Start in the Dragon Knights
episodes.synopsis: Hadis, Jill, and the others head to the imperial capital, Rahelm. As they near the city, they're suddenly attacked! Jill and the others spring into action. Amidst the fighting, the leader of the other forces accuses Hadis of being a false emperor.

episodes.title: I, the Dragon Consort, Am Now Hated by the Dragon and I Want to Find a Way to Be Friendly Again
episodes.synopsis: Jill has been accepted into the Dragon Knights, but during an aptitude test referred to as dragon initiation, Captain Elentzia's dragon does something unexpected and the test is cut short. Jill heads home feeling useless... until Hadis talks to her.

episodes.title: My Fiance and I Nearly Ripped Each Other to Shreds and It May Still End Up Being a Bloodbath
episodes.synopsis: Risteard brings Hadis to Elentzia. Jill encourages Hadis to talk to them, which leads to a shocking development. In the midst of their negotiations, a dragon knight enters with news that a force has arrived to burn down the town!

episodes.title: As a Result of Doing-over My Life, I Find Myself out of Options Once Again
episodes.synopsis: At the castle, Elentzia asks Jill to look after her little brothers. The party leaves, hoping to meet up with reinforcements, but wary of a trap. Jill reminds herself that she's there to make sure Hadis never feels alone.

episodes.title: My Fiance`s Uncle Is Behaving So Outrageously That I Can No Longer Stand Silently By
episodes.synopsis: Hadis has been betrayed. An unexpected intervention allows Jill to escape certain death, but drops her into another dire situation. Jill finds herself face to face with an angry dragon, and her powers are still sealed away!

episodes.title: The Do-Over Damsel Conquers the Dragon Emperor
episodes.synopsis: The truth of the Rave imperial family is revealed. Hadis explodes with rage. His expression, twisted with hate and despair, is exactly the same as that of the Hadis Jill knows from the future. Will she be able to save him this time?

info.title: Promise of Wizard
info.synopsis: In un mondo in cui i maghi e gli umani coesistono, ci sono cinque paesi nel continente centrale, tutti con caratteristiche uniche. In questo mondo, un grande satellite fluttua nel cielo e i cittadini si sentono in pericolo. Una volta all'anno, vengono selezionati dei maghi che combattono contro quel misterioso corpo celeste. Ad uno di loro, proveniente da un altro mondo, è chiesto di condurre la squadra contro quel satellite.

episodes.title: The Wind Is Strong, and the Cats Are in a Frenzy
episodes.synopsis: On a bright night illuminated by the full moon, Akira steps into her apartment's elevator and encounters a man who's dressed bizarrely and tells her many strange things then disappears. Once the elevator doors open, she finds herself in another world.

episodes.title: Those Who Defy the Cruel Moon
episodes.synopsis: The Maledictor from the East, Faust, had protected one of his comrades in the last battle against the Great Calamity and was gravely injured. Akira visits him after being told she might be able to save him. She then meets various wizards from the Northern Country and the most powerful wizard, Oz.

episodes.title: A Heartfelt Breakfast
episodes.synopsis: It's decided that a ritual to summon new wizards will be performed. The only one who can perform this ritual is the Sage, Akira. While preparations were being done for the ritual, Akira was reading notes about the wizards in the Sage's Tome to get closer to them.

episodes.title: The Unknown, Fear, and Mutual Prosperity
episodes.synopsis: Akira and the wizards meet the new wizards that Akira successfully summoned.

episodes.title: A Mixer with Some Free-Willed Wizards
episodes.synopsis: Akira and the wizards hold a mixer and then, Akira, Cain, Riquet, and Arthur head north to see Oz.

episodes.title: Something Someone as Innocent as You Can Do
episodes.synopsis: Akira and the wizards get ready to head to their parade in the Central Country.

episodes.title: Uninvited Guests at the Party
episodes.synopsis: The wizards and Akira enjoy themselves at the party held for them but then some uninvited guests show up.

episodes.title: The Fragments of the Distorted Miracle
episodes.synopsis: Akira and a few of her wizards go investigate a graveyard.

episodes.title: A Melancholic Dance on Thin Ice
episodes.synopsis: Owen is suspected of trying to murder Nicholas and Chloe gives a scarf to a friend.

episodes.title: I Can Keep Walking Even If I`m All Alone
episodes.synopsis: Akira and the wizards head back to the Wizards' Hall after the incident with Owen in the Central Country.

episodes.title: The Bird of Omen Awakens
episodes.synopsis: There seems to be something peculiar about Owen and Snow and White remember the truth about the Umbra Volans.

episodes.title: May Your World Be Blessed
episodes.synopsis: Akira and the wizards face off with Nova.

info.title: Prison Lab
info.synopsis: Aito Eyama è un liceale giornalmente vittima di bullismo. Un giorno gli viene recapitata una strana lettera che lo invita a partecipare al "gioco della prigionia": potrà scegliere una persona da tenere in prigionia per un mese, e potrebbe anche vincere una grossa somma di denaro. La scelta di Aito ricade su Aya Kirishima, leader dei bulli. L'unica regola del gioco è di non uccidere la persona imprigionata, tutto il resto è concesso. Inizia così la vendetta di Eyama.

info.title: Carried by the Wind: Tsukikage Ran
info.synopsis: La serie segue le vicende di Ran e Miao, due vagabondi che affrontano tutti i tipi di antagonisti nel Giappone dell'era Tokugawa.

episodes.title: She`s Tough, for a Woman
episodes.synopsis: Ran Tsukikage is a ronin (masterless samurai) with an empty stomach and a love of good sake. Myao is a martial artist with a quick fist and a strong sense of justice. Wandering the countryside, the two women end up drawn into a conflict involving a nearby village being plagued by bullies.

episodes.title: Sake Made the Tears Sting
episodes.synopsis: Ran's travels take her to a village where the mayor is committing the unforgivable crimes of watering down sake and overcharging for it. As a woman who knows the value of a good sake, Ran vows to make things right so that people can enjoy a proper drink.

episodes.title: Suddenly, I Was a Mother
episodes.synopsis: Myao was just stopping by a castle town when suddenly she finds herself plus one abandoned baby. Even as she tries to get used to the idea of being a mother, Myao and Ran discover that the baby is key to a much more sinister plot.

episodes.title: I Was a Target Before I Knew It
episodes.synopsis: Ran and Myao once again run into each other. This time, they find themselves in trouble when a starving Myao steals from an offering box, forcing the two of them to pay back the stolen money. Then they learn of a map said to lead to loot stolen from the town by bandits.

episodes.title: It Was Pretty Amazing When I Stripped
episodes.synopsis: Myao gets recruited by an artist who is interested in her posing in the nude for a painting. Meanwhile, all the town's young women seem to be mysteriously disappearing. Could there be a connection?

episodes.title: The Mole Was in the Wrong Place
episodes.synopsis: Word about the female samurai Ran and the martial artist Myao is spreading. First they're accused of being criminals, then they're welcomed with open arms. Why are the people aware of two wanderers? And why the criminal accusations?

episodes.title: I Buzzed With Electricity
episodes.synopsis: Myao comes across a young man who seems to be engaged in a strange experiment. He claims to be flying a kite so as to be able to draw electricity from the sky. Is that really possible?

episodes.title: There Was No God In This World
episodes.synopsis: Myao has a crick in her neck. What a coincidence that she and Ran run into a group of faith healers. But is their intense training regimen the key to good health or just another scam?

episodes.title: I Counted On An Enemy
episodes.synopsis: Myao happens to learn about an old friend of hers, and she and Ran decide to drop in for some friendly hospitality. But a little digging reveals that Myao's friend found her good fortune through foul means.

episodes.title: The European Girl Was Huge
episodes.synopsis: Talk about large and in charge. First, Ran develops an unhealthy fixation for elephants. Then, she and Myao run across the biggest woman they've ever seen: towering over even the tallest man. The strangest fact of all? She's a foreigner!

episodes.title: Vengeance Made Himself An Enemy
episodes.synopsis: Myao happens across a young brother and sister who seem to want to pick a fight with anyone. Then they cross paths with Ran, and she and Myao learn that the truth is stranger still.

episodes.title: I Was So Crucified, I Didn`t Know What To Do
episodes.synopsis: Myao is entrusted by a dying woman to deliver a package to a nearby town. Inside is...a plate? Little does she realize, that one plate is about to throw her into her biggest misadventure yet.

episodes.title: She Hid A Romance In The Past
episodes.synopsis: Ran is a wandering samurai with incredible skill and a love of good sake. Both came from a man in her past. It is the strangest of coincidences that man and woman should cross paths one more time; stranger still that they will also cross swords.

info.title: Jungle Emperor Leo
info.synopsis: Il film è ambientato in un momento imprecisato del XXI secolo, in cui la terra ha subito gravissime devastazioni ambientali e le Nazioni Unite hanno commissionato a un’impresa privata la costruzione di giungle artificiali in cui gli animali selvatici sono costretti a vivere. Leo (Kimba) è nato in questo ambiente artificiale, la sua vita è sempre stata facile e non sembra essere molto coraggioso: ma lui vuole diventarlo. La storia inizia quando Leo e Kenichi, un ragazzino che ha la capacità di comprendere il linguaggio degli animali, si incontrano. Speciale prodotto per la celebrazione del cinquantesimo anniversario di Fuji TV e dell’ottantesimo compleanno di Osamu Tezuka.

episodes.title: TV Special
episodes.synopsis:
Earth, sometime in the 21st century. Because of non-stop environmental destruction, the United Nations commissions a private company, "Eternal Earth", to create an artificial jungle, to be a nature preserve and to protect animals. All wild animals are forced to live in it.

The animals that live in this "neo-jungle" have an easy life. Leo, son of Panja, is born in this artificial world. Because of the unrealistic nature of the neo-jungle, Leo lives his life like he hasn't a care in the world. But Leo is ridiculed by the other animals; they call him a coward--he is not like his father, the great Jungle Emperor, but Leo vows that some day he will be.

Kenichi, son of the Eternal Earth company's CEO, has no doubt about the great success of the neo-jungle. The story starts when Leo and Kenichi meet. Kenichi has the special ability to understand what the animals are saying.

Source: www.kimbawlion.com/2009.htm

info.title: Parasite Dolls (ITA)
info.synopsis: Anno 2034. A Megatokyo, gli androidi convivono da anni con gli esseri umani e, col passare del tempo, il loro aspetto è diventato sempre più simile a quello dei loro creatori. Questa convivenza non sempre è delle più pacifiche e i crimini ad opera di questi androidi sono in aumento. Per questo motivo è stato creato un reparto speciale della polizia chiamato A.D. Police

episodes.title: A Faint Voice
episodes.synopsis: Year 2034, Tokyo is where human beings and boomers coexist. The A.D. Police sets up a new special agent-"Branch" to investigate crimes committed by Boomers. Agent Basil and his partner boomer Kimball procured a mysterious drug while investigating crime cases that are frequently committed by mad boomers. They find out astonishing facts while they get closer to the core of the case.

info.title: Godzilla: Planet of the Monsters (ITA)
info.synopsis:
Ultima estate del 20° secolo: l'umanità scopre di non essere la sola razza dominante sulla Terra. Giganteschi mostri emergono dagli angoli più remoti e nascosti del pianeta e, fra questi kaiju, l'immenso Godzilla sembra il solo capace di affrontarli e distruggerli. Dopo una feroce guerra durata mezzo secolo e segnata da innumerevoli sconfitte e massacri, i governi della Terra decidono di abbandonare il pianeta cercando la salvezza in una pericolosa migrazione verso un altro mondo, individuato a 11,9 anni luce di distanza. Le risorse rimaste sono concentrate nella costruzione di una nave interstellare, l'Aratrum, capace di compiere il viaggio in pochi decenni. Non tutti partiranno: l'equipaggio della nave viene scelto da un'intelligenza artificiale! A loro il compito di varcare l'abisso spaziale e fondare una nuova Terra.
Il viaggio dell'Aratrum, durato venti anni, si rivela un colossale fiasco. Il pianeta individuato non è adatto a sostenere la vita umana. Dell'equipaggio fa parte anche Haruno, che a soli quattro anni ha visto i suoi genitori uccisi da Godzilla. Per tutto il lungo viaggio ha continuato a covare il suo desiderio di vendetta contro il mostro. Quando una parte dell'equipaggio dell'Aratrum decide di tornare verso la Terra, il giovane si unisce a loro. Nessuno sa che il viaggio di ritorno è, se possibile, ancora più infausto.
Cercando pericolose scorciatoie nell'iperspazio per ridurre quanto più possibile i tempi del ritorno, l'equipaggio dell'Aratrum finisce per commettere un errore fatale: con sgomento, quando la Terra riappare davanti a loro, scoprono di aver compiuto involontariamente un vero viaggio nel tempo! Si ritrovano sbalzati di 20.000 anni nel futuro, con un pianeta molto cambiato, diventato veramente il pianeta dei mostri, e su di esso Godzilla regna incontrastato. Riusciranno gli umani a riconquistare il proprio pianeta? Quale destino attende Haruno?

Godzilla: City on the Edge of Battle

info.title: Zatsu Tabi: That's Journey
info.synopsis: Chika Suzugamori è una studentessa universitaria che, dopo aver vinto un premio per mangaka esordienti, continua a proporre alcuni manga agli editori venendo puntualmente rifiutata. Proprio quando stava per perdere la speranza di entrare in questa industria, decide per capriccio di partire per un viaggio senza alcuno scopo particolare.

episodes.title: The First 1,225 Steps
episodes.synopsis: Manga artist Suzugamori Chika goes on a journey guided by poll results. Her first destination: Aizuwakamatsu.

episodes.title: The Real Deal! A Lively Journey for Two
episodes.synopsis: Chika visits Matsushima alone and feels a little lonely. Koyomi joins her journey to Kurobe in Toyama.

episodes.title: Perfect the Way It Is
episodes.synopsis: Chika and her junior Yui go on their first journey together to Takamatsu, Kagawa, in the Shikoku region.

episodes.title: Smile by the Sea
episodes.synopsis: Chika travels to Kyoto with manga artists Fuyune and Riri and gets inspired by their creative process.

episodes.title: Crows, Dragons, Soba, and a Remote Island
episodes.synopsis: Chika journeys to Tochigi alone and then to Awashima with Koyomi.

episodes.title: An Epic Midsummer Journey!
episodes.synopsis: Chika's Awashima journey with Koyomi ends, and Yui joins for "The Epic Summer Journey: Tokyo Arc."

episodes.title: A City Where You Can Meet Gods? And Then...
episodes.synopsis: Chika visits the Ise Shrine with Riri. Then, Yoshimoto sends her off on a night bus trip with Yui and Fuyune.

episodes.title: Three Girls, Cozy and Full of Laughs
episodes.synopsis: Chika explores Hiroshima with Fuyune and Yui. She then produces a draft that gets approved by her editor.

episodes.title: Completion at the Hot Spring, Then the First Sunrise
episodes.synopsis: Chika goes on a solo journey to Aomori and then to Wakayama to see the first sunrise of the year.

episodes.title: Home in My Heart
episodes.synopsis: After Chika returns from her solo journey in Wakayama, Koyomi joins her for a journey to Hanamaki in Iwate.

episodes.title: A Pilgrimage with Master
episodes.synopsis: Chika visits Izumo-Taisha in Shimane with Fuyune, where she finds out that Fuyune and Riri had an argument.

episodes.title: That`s Journey
episodes.synopsis: Riri makes a surprise appearance, inspiring Chika. Yoshimoto offers Chika a shot to get her one-off published.

info.title: Blood: The Last Vampire
info.synopsis: La storia si svolge nella base statunitense Yokota Air Base in Giappone, qualche mese prima della guerra in Vietnam. La protagonista, Saya, è una cacciatrice di vampiri (nel film chiamati chirotteri) che utilizza una katana e lavora per un'associazione conosciuta come Red Shield. Saya (come si intuisce dal titolo del film) è un vampiro originale, l'ultimo. Saya non teme la luce, ma sembra essere infastidita dai simboli religiosi. Poco prima della festività di Halloween, Saya riceve l'incarico di trovare e uccidere due chirotteri che si nascondono nella base e, per farlo, si iscrive nella scuola, dove scopre che le sue prede si nascondono proprio tra gli studenti.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: Teropterids are evil beasts which pose as humans and live only to drink human blood. Fortunately for the human world there are groups dedicated to destroying them. A brooding and mysterious girl named Saya is the best teropterid slayer there is, and now, in 1960's Japan, she is sent to a U. S. army base which may be infested...

info.title: Murder Princess
info.synopsis: Nel pacifico regno di Forland un uomo di corte, il dottor Akamashi, ordisce un colpo di stato assieme ai due robot di sua invenzione; eliminato il re Riamne, non resta che eliminare la figlia, la principessa Alita, unica erede al trono rimasta. Alita però è riuscita a fuggire, e nella sua corsa disperata finisce per precipitare da un burrone. Cadendo, Alita travolge la mercenaria Falis, che passava di lì con la sua banda. Inspiegabilmente quando le due ragazze riprendono i sensi, scoprono di essersi scambiate i corpi. Toccherà quindi a Falis - nei panni di un'Alita forte e determinata - proteggere il regno dai piani di conquista del malvagio dottore.

episodes.title: Birth
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Akamashi initiates a coup d’etat in the Forland kingdom, forcing Alita, the Forland princess, to flee in the hopes of reaching her brother. A short while later in a border forest, Alita accidentally pushes the bounty hunter Falis off a cliff while fleeing from the forest guardian beast who killed her entourage of castle guards. This results in Alita and Falis switching bodies due to the near-death experience. Falis accepts Alita's plea to protect the Forland kingdom after Alita offers her own body and soul as collateral.

episodes.title: Coronation
episodes.synopsis: Falis, now in the body of Alita, liberates the Forland castle from Dr. Akamashi and his henchrobots, Ana and Yuna. The real Alita, now in the body of Falis, assumes the role of Jodu's deceased granddaughter Milano, who died while acting as a substitute for Alita. In Alita's place, Falis is crowned as the Queen of Forland. However, the coronation parade is disturbed by Dr. Akamashi's evil plans.

episodes.title: Return
episodes.synopsis: Falis and Alita get into an argument, and Falis goes off to vent her steam on the encroaching goblins. During this time, Akamashi's aides kidnap Alita and interrogate her about her real identity and about the "key". Falis goes to the rescue but is coerced into dropping her weapon. A swordsman then leaps onto the scene and saves the day; he turns out to be none other than Prince Kaito, Alita's brother.

episodes.title: Exile
episodes.synopsis: Since the prince has returned and is soon to be crowned, Falis plans to leave the next day. Alita says she'll be lonely, but she's told Falis will return when she finds a way to swap bodies again. Later in the evening, Falis is called by the mysterious hooded woman and led into a secret chamber in the castle. They fight and Alita and the others come down to help her, but they run into the two androids and the professor. Suddenly the professor is stabbed by the black armored knight, and the two androids are also defeated. Falis is badly beaten by the knight, who reveals himself to be Kaito in front of all the guests. He claims that Falis is a false princess and that the others are rebels. The four of them are forced to flee the kingdom and Kaito is crowned as king.

episodes.title: Fate
episodes.synopsis: Falis, Alita and their companions manage to evade capture thanks to a group of travelling entertainers. When they stop to take a break, they begin to discuss the circumstances behind everything that has transpired so far. It turns out that the root cause to all this is the Lost Technology, which was entrusted to the House Forland after the demise of the Old World and is protected by a seal that can only be opened by female members of the House.

episodes.title: Determination`s End
episodes.synopsis: Falis, Milano, and the rest of the group returns to the kingdom in order to stop Kaito from using Teoria. However, they also decide to use the powers of Teoria to switch their bodies back to their original ways. Unfortunately, Kaito makes it to the Teorial chamber first, knocking out Falis and capturing Milano. Kaito then wishes for the entire world to end, activating Teoria's great power.

info.title: Uglymug, Epicfighter
info.synopsis: Shigeru Yoshioka era un venditore talentuoso ma con un aspetto poco attraente, tanto da guadagnarsi il soprannome di "busamen leggendario". Tuttavia un giorno, dopo essere stato arrestato per delle molestie che non aveva commesso, finisce per perdere il lavoro e diventa estremamente ginofobico. Tornando a vivere nella casa dei genitori come un recluso, trova una possibilità per una seconda vita in una bacheca su internet che parla di misteriose sparizioni che stanno avvenendo in maniera indiscriminata in tutto il mondo. Incuriosito dalla cosa, Shigeru risponde a un messaggio che gli compare a schermo e, quasi per gioco, inizia a impostare dei parametri del suo personaggio per un RPG online: per non aver a che fare con le donne decide di abbassare il più possibile tutti i parametri che potrebbero renderlo popolare, come ad esempio l'aspetto, per concentrarsi soprattutto su forza e abilità nel combattimento. Queste scelte lo portano ad avere una serie di parametri bonus che si discostano totalmente dal comune buon senso. Scaduto il tempo di creazione del personaggio Shigeru si mette a dormire mentre pensa al fatto che tutto ciò sia stato solo una perdita di tempo, ma al suo risveglio non si ritrova più nella sua stanza, e sembra sia finito nel corpo del personaggio che aveva creato...

episodes.title: An Epicgod Is Born
episodes.synopsis: Shigeru Yoshioka is a very ugly man who tries to reincarnate in another world, disgusted with life.

Qui si prende cura degli ospiti, aiutandoli a ritrovare serenità e fiducia. Al suo fianco c’è Psyduck, goffo ma affettuoso, che la accompagna in questo viaggio di crescita personale e scoperta interiore.

episodes.title: I Hope I Can Evolve Too...

info.title: Doraemon il film: Nobita e gli eroi dello spazio
info.synopsis: Nobita, Shizuka, Gian e Suneo impazziscono letteralmente per una nuova serie televisiva: "gli eroi dello spazio". Nobita, in particolare, sogna ad occhi aperti davanti al televisore di diventare un grande supereroe proprio come i suoi beniamini in tv. Decide così di girare un film di supereroi! peccato che Gian, Suneo e Shizuka, lo abbiano anticipato escludendolo dal progetto. Nobita, disperato, si rivolge a Doraemon che, grazie a un Chiusky Robot capace di creare degli straordinari scenari virtuali, riesce a convincere i ragazzi a includere lui e Nobita nel progetto. Insieme iniziano a filmare le prime scene, ma ben presto si ritrovano catapultati in una realtà che va ben oltre la loro immaginazione. Un abitante di un pianeta lontano, Aron, chiede loro aiuto per salvare il proprio popolo da un gruppo di malvagi pirati spaziali. I ragazzi, convinti che Aron faccia parte della sceneggiatura del film, accettano la missione senza esitare. Anche se ben presto si accorgeranno di non essere su un set cinematografico, dimostreranno ugualmente di essere degli eroi anche nella realtà.

episodes.title: The Athlete`s Pledge
episodes.synopsis: The Chubu Block championship arrives, bringing Inori her chance to qualify for the All-Japans Novice Contest. At the venue, Inori is overwhelmed with emotion at finally being in the place she has always dreamed of. There, she meets the other Novice A skaters, but the atmosphere shifts when former Olympian Riina Kojoh appears.

episodes.title: My Cards
episodes.synopsis: A game of musical chairs for the top five spots at the All-Japans begins. With one of the most talented skaters of their generation absent from the competition, everyone now has a real chance at winning.

episodes.title: The Queen`s Leap
episodes.synopsis: The second group, including Inori, take their turn at the championship. With only three skaters to go, Yuna Yagi steps onto the ice. Despite promising her coach she will stick to their planned program, she finds herself hesitating mid-performance.

episodes.title: Ascendance
episodes.synopsis: It is Inori's turn to step onto the ice. Tsukasa has crafted a strategy that plays to Inori's strengths, with a trump card for the final stretch.

episodes.title: Beacon
episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa finds himself in an unexpected situation skating alongside legends Jun Yodaka and Shinichiro Sonidori. As he watches Jun move across the ice with breathtaking skill, something stirs within him.

episodes.title: Intensive Training
episodes.synopsis: Inori joins an intensive training session with the Chubu Block competitors heading to the All-Japans. Reuniting with Hikaru and the other skaters, she quickly realises there is a gap in her abilities that she had not anticipated.

episodes.title: The Frozen Lake
episodes.synopsis: A training session with jump specialist Kakeru Uobuchi brings remarkable results, and Tsukasa is so impressed he decides to invest in his own harness equipment. He brings it to the ice rink intending to help Inori master jumps.

episodes.title: Hot Passion
episodes.synopsis: Inori and Tsukasa arrive at Niigata skating rink in the early morning, seeking Coach Uobuchi's guidance. After observing Inori's skating, Uobuchi presents them with an unexpected proposition.

episodes.title: It Begins
episodes.synopsis: At the Niigata rink, Inori and Tsukasa cross paths with Miku Ahiru, a formidable competitor, along with her coach Kohei Kamogawa and choreographer Juna Shiratori, both former clubmates of Tsukasa's. When Inori speaks with Miku, she discovers something unexpected about her rival's future in skating. Meanwhile, Tsukasa finds himself confronting uncomfortable truths about his abilities as a coach. With the competition approaching, both Inori and Tsukasa face questions that could reshape their path forward.

info.title: Tokyo Godfathers
info.synopsis: Tre senza tetto trovano, in una magica vigilia di Natale, un bambino abbandonato nella spazzatura. Dopo qualche discussione decidono di riportarlo direttamente alla madre, senza passare per la polizia. Con i pochi indizi che hanno i disposizione, inizia una sgangherata ricerca, nella quale i protagonisti finiranno per confrontarsi con i propri passati…

info.title: Do You Like Big Girls?
info.synopsis: Sōta Tachibana è un freeter poliedrico che passa da un lavoro part-time all’altro, distinguendosi soprattutto per la sua bassa statura. La sua vita cambia quando la sorella maggiore Kaoru, alta quasi due metri, lo coinvolge come assistente nella squadra di pallavolo femminile dell’università di cui fa parte. Sōta si ritrova così a lavorare a stretto contatto con un gruppo di ragazze tutte molto alte, atletiche e dalla forte personalità, finendo per essere immerso in un ambiente completamente nuovo per lui. La sua presenza, così diversa da quella delle giocatrici, attira rapidamente la loro attenzione, dando vita a dinamiche vivaci e spesso imbarazzanti.

episodes.title: Do You Like "Big Girls"?
episodes.synopsis: Tall Kaori and short Sota are siblings by marriage. One day, commanded by Kaori, Sota becomes the dorm manager and coach for her university women's volleyball team. Among the members is Ayano, his first love, and they have an unexpected reunion! Sota begins living together with the club members as the dorm manager. But that night, he witnesses an unexpected side of Ayano, whom he's always admired...?!

episodes.title: The Target! All Eyes On Sota
episodes.synopsis: Kaori, who had suggested the date herself, becomes flustered upon learning that Sota and Ayano went to a hotel. Still, as Sota's sister, she tries to mediate between them... Meanwhile, Sakura, Kyoka, and Yuria, having heard the whole story, come up with a bizarre theory: Since they're also members of the girls' volleyball club like Ayano, they should have the right to do the same thing! And so, they begin seducing Sota!

episodes.title: Do You Like Tiny Girls Too?
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is present at the girls' dormitory, now with the club president, Sanae, who had been absent for a while due to family circumstances, returning to the volleyball club. Sanae, a libero specializing in defense, is petite despite being on the volleyball team, and Sota finds himself drawn to her, who is shorter than him. The group decides to hold a Genghis Khan party to celebrate Sanae's return and Sota's appointment as coach. But that night, an unexpected hint of romance awaited Sota!

episodes.title: The Cherry Blossom Season The Pure-Hearted Girl with Glasses
episodes.synopsis: Sakura is always full of jokes. One day, when Sota tells her that she'd be cute if she just acted normal, a certain memory resurfaces. Back in elementary school, Sakura, already tall for her age, played the clown while spending her days with her male friend, Takeshi. Eventually, they entered middle school and both joined the volleyball club. However, a rift gradually formed between Sakura, blessed with physique and talent, and Takeshi, who was not...

episodes.title: You Are The Grand Prize!
episodes.synopsis: One night, Kaori, wearing only her underwear, comes to Sota's room seeking help. Sota is shocked, but it turns out the club members were holding a strip mahjong tournament. With Kaori facing certain defeat, she makes a last-ditch effort to recruit Sota as her substitute player. The tournament's grand prize was... the right to do whatever they wanted with Sota?! Reluctant but needing to protect himself, Sota joins the game. Meanwhile, Kaori seems to have her own thoughts on the matter...

episodes.title: Kyoka's Top Secret
episodes.synopsis: Last night's events left Sota feeling awkward. Kaori forcefully tries to act like nothing happened, but Sota's words about Sanae stirs something within her. Amidst this, a secret about Kyoka is revealed?! While it was quietly known among the club members, the shock of it coming out causes Kyoka to flee. Mental care is also an important job for the dorm manager and coach... Sota hurriedly chases after her!

episodes.title: Go! Go! Julia!
episodes.synopsis: The gym gets double-booked by both the volleyball and basketball teams. They decide to settle it with a game, and the sport Julia proposes is none other than basketball?! There's no way they stand a chance against the basketball team at their own game, and naturally, the members voice their discontent. But Julia is strangely confident, and Sota decides to trust her. And so, the match between the volleyball team and basketball team begins!

episodes.title: Who Do You Really Like?
episodes.synopsis: The girls from the dorm head to the shopping district for supplies. They came to buy groceries, but Sota gets thoroughly swayed again by the members' self-indulgent, free-spirited actions. After much commotion, they manage to finish shopping and discover they can try their luck at a lucky draw. The grand prize is a pair of hot spring trip vouchers! Kaoru, concerned about Sanae and Sota's relationship, wins it and wants to give it to them, but...

episodes.title: A Valentine's Kiss
episodes.synopsis: Today is Valentine's Day! Kaoru and Kyoka, with their tall figure and short hair, are treated like princesses and receive chocolates from their female fans. Seeing this, Sanae and Ayano decide they want to make some for Sota too, and eventually the whole club ends up making homemade chocolates. Kaoru also hands Sota the chocolate she made herself. It contains something not found in ordinary family chocolates...

episodes.title: Let's Go on a Date!
episodes.synopsis: Kaoru couldn't shake the words Ayano had said to her on Valentine's Day night regarding her feelings for Sota. Then, in a sudden turn of events, Kaoru finds herself running out of the dorm in her nightclothes. Sota, who had followed her, invites her on a date. They go clothes shopping together, eat dinner, and drink out. But then, drunk, Kaoru declares she doesn't want to go home...!

episodes.title: The Witch of Toyohira
episodes.synopsis: The unexpected date with Sota begins. Fueled by alcohol, Kaoru ends up going into a hotel with him, reminiscing about their childhood. Tall and nicknamed the "Witch of Toyohira," Kaoru often protected the smaller, bullied Sota. Kaoru advised him that if he really fought back, things will work out—but that advice relied on Kaoru's own physique. What is the surprising suggestion Kaoru makes to Sota who has half-given up...?

episodes.title: Do You "Like" Big Girls?
episodes.synopsis: Kaoru and Sota both return to the dorm in the morning, in a mess—Kaoru hungover, Sota with facial injuries. Kaoru had almost no memory of the night, but vaguely recalls that something good had happened. Amidst this, in front of everyone, Julia eventually makes a remark that Kaoru likes Sota?! This happy harem story set in Hokkaido comes to an end for now!

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Takes On a New Position
episodes.synopsis: A few months into his appointment as the Liberion Order's special instructor, Beryl Gardenant is settling into his new life in the capital. One day, he's visited by Lucy and Ficelle, who ask him to become a temporary instructor at the Magic Institute. Beryl joins the sword magic course where Mewi is enrolled, witnesses Ficelle's teaching methods, and finds himself facing off against her...

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Watches Them Grow
episodes.synopsis: Beryl wrestles with teaching Ficelle - who is a terrible teacher - how to actually teach. Mewi struggles to fit in with her fellow students, but a conversation with Cindy at lunch hints at that beginning to change. At a small party, Beryl views both Mewi and Ficelle's growth with satisfaction. And then an unexpected disturbance rocks the Magic Institute.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Sees Himself in an Old Man
episodes.synopsis: Wolf-shaped shadows attack the teachers and magic is rendered useless on campus. Able to fight even without magic, Beryl and Ficelle force their way into the school in an effort to uncover the cause of the strange happenings. When shadow wolves appear in the cafeteria, Mewi and her classmates decide to confront them, despite their inexperience. Two battles unfold - so how will they end?

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Returns Home
episodes.synopsis: A letter addressed to Beryl arrives from Beaden. Sent by his father Mordea, it urges him to return to the village for an annual event unique to the village. With the Magic Institute on summer break, Beryl invites Mewi to accompany him and Henblitz. Then Curuni invites herself along. It's the first time Beryl's been home since his move to the city. The next day, an unexpected confrontation occurs.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Lets Out a Roar
episodes.synopsis: Their mission to take down the saberboar begins. Curuni achieves her long-cherished goal of taking one down and realizes how much stronger she has become. Randrid makes full use of the skills he honed as an adventurer and puts his swordsmanship to good use. Impressed, Henblitz challenges him to a sparring match - which ignites something in the hearts of both Beryl and another swordsman.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Faces Off Against His Father
episodes.synopsis: With the saberboar threat eliminated, Beaden holds its annual festival. The friendship between Henblitz and Randrid grows, while Adel and Edel fuss over Mewi. Beryl watches it all and reflects on his own feelings over the years. Then Mordea arrives and the two head for the dojo. Can Beryl overcome the giant wall that is his father?

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets an Invitation from Nobility
episodes.synopsis: A banquet is being held in the lands of the Margrave of Flumvelk, a region bordering Sphenedyardvania, and both Allucia and Beryl have been invited. The visit is also a chance to confirm the route the soon-to-be-wed Princess Salacia will take to her new home. Along the way, Beryl gives advice to a young knight. When he arrives at his destination, an unexpected reunion awaits him.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets a Marriage Proposal
episodes.synopsis: Shueste, the sister of Beryl's former student Warren, relentlessly pursues Beryl - but for a good reason. Seeing this upsets Allucia, Warren explains both his and Shueste's motives, and encourages Allucia to make her own move. Beryl's actions at the banquet leave Shueste even more smitten. Having finished their assignment, Beryl and Allucia head home - but face an unforseen encounter on the way.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes to the Holy City
episodes.synopsis: Back in the capital, Beryl struggles to shake his guilt over Vesper's grave injuries, while Surena tries to cheer him up. The day of Princess Salacia's wedding draws near, and Beryl joins the escort detail. After a short reunion with Shueste and with the threat of an attack by the Verdapis Mercenary Company looming, they reach Dilmahakha, the holy city of Sphenedyardvania. But who is watching him?

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Sees in the New Year
episodes.synopsis: Allucia and Gatoga visit Beryl at his lodgings in Dilmahakha, and Gatoga shows Beryl around the city. Once they're alone, Gatoga tells him what became of Rose. Back in Baltrain, Curuni and Ficelle put Mewi through special training, while Lucy and Ibroy meet in secret. The new year arrives, bringing Princess Salacia's wedding - and screams of terror ring out through the cathedral.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Flies into a Rage
episodes.synopsis: The Verdapis Mercenary Company bursts into the cathedral. Beryl moves to stop them, but Ibroy yells, "They're on our side!" Forced into an uneasy alliance, Beryl and the others escort the prince and princess safely to the palace. Along the way, Beryl's rage clashes with Hanoy's pride as a mercenary. But an even greater crisis engulfs the Holy City - caused by none other than Pope Morris himself.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes Home
episodes.synopsis: The masked White Maiden is revealed to be none other than Beryl's former student, Rose. Beryl and the White Maiden meet up with Allucia and Surena, who have successfully taken down the Chimera, and they head to back up the Verdapis Mercenary Company. There, they find Hanoy on the brink of defeat - and Pope Morris standing calmly before him. The final battle is about to begin.

info.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime the Movie: Tears of the Azure Sea (ITA)
info.synopsis: Dopo aver concluso la cerimonia di apertura della "Federazione del Regno dei Demoni di Tempest", Rimuru e i suoi compagni sono invitati dall’Imperatrice Celeste Hermesia della grande nazione elfica a visitare la sua isola privata. Mentre il gruppo si gode la sua breve vacanza, appare una donna misteriosa di nome Yura e, improvvisamente, avviene uno strano incidente sullo sfondo del mare azzurro sconfinato...

info.title: Vertex Force
info.synopsis: Akira vive una vita tranquilla insieme alla sorella maggiore Haruka e alla madre, che gestisce un caffè. La famiglia, tuttavia, nasconde un segreto: Haruka ha ereditato dal padre un potere chiamato "Engine" e lo tiene nascosto agli altri. Akira, d'altra parte, non ha ereditato il potere del padre e soffre di un complesso d'inferiorità a questo proposito. Nel frattempo, strani eventi iniziano a verificarsi in tutto il mondo.

episodes.title: Engine, Ignition
episodes.synopsis: When the global network is disrupted, Haruka must use a power inherited from her father to protect her family.

episodes.title: Vertex
episodes.synopsis: Just after Akira's hidden power reveals itself, two unfamiliar women appear before him.

episodes.title: Ardent Feelings
episodes.synopsis: Haruka and Akira depart for Hokkaido with Eleanor and Lala to find the fifth Vertex.

episodes.title: Brother and Sister
episodes.synopsis: On a deserted island, Lala devises a plan to use Akira as bait to lure EDVA to them.
